method: Summon • Demon Parade • Wanted Quests • Dispatch

skills.name: Roaming Fish (游鱼/遊魚)
skills.line: The weak do not belong on the battlefield!
skills.description: Lord Arakawa forms water into a fish to assault a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Empowering Flow (逐流)
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Lord Arakawa deals an extra 20% of damage when inflicting crits. At the start of battle, he gains Empowering Flow, lasts for 1 turn. ;Empowering Flow (逐流) : :'''General, Mark''': Decreases DEF by 20%. Ignores 120 DEF when dealing damage. After accumulating damage equal to 50% of his own max HP, uses Swallow on an enemy with no onibi cost (max once per turn).

upgrades.text: Empowering Flow trigger condition decreased to 40% of his max HP.
Empowering Flow trigger condition decreased to 30% of his max HP.
Inflicts additional 20% HP Steal on crits.
'''Empowering Flow''': When affected by move bar decreasing effects, increases his move bar by 30% instead (max 2 times before own turn starts).

skills.name: Swallow (吞噬)
skills.line: The weak should be dragged to the deepest, darkest depths of the sea.
skills.description:
Lord Arakawa forms water into a shoal of fish to inflict a 2-strike attack on 1 enemy, dealing damage equal to 53% of his ATK with the first strike and has a 100% base chance of inflicting Isolation on them, lasts for 2 turn. Then deals damage equal to 211% of his ATK with the second strike. After using this skin, he gains Reign, lasts for 2 turns. ;Reign (君臨) : :'''Buff, Mark''': When using Swallow, additionally performs 2 follow-up attacks on the 2 enemies with the lowest HP, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK with each attack.
;Isolation : :'''Debuff, Status''': Damage received cannot be shared or redirected by soul effects or shikigami skills/passives.

upgrades.text: Damage for the second strike increases to 226%.
Damage for the second strike increases to 241%.
Damage for the second strike increases to 256%.
Damage for the second strike increases to 270%.
